topic: Introduction to the Session in Honor of Rex Reklaitis' 70th Birthday
title: Introduction to the Session in Honor of Rex Reklaitis' 70th Birthday
session_title: In Honor of Rex Reklaitis' 70 th Birthday
abstract: This is a presenting in the session in honor of Rex Reklaitis' 70th birthday at the AIChE Meeting in San Franscisco in 2013. The presentations are all invited and aim at describing the many contributions of Rex in the area of Process Systems Engineering. We will have a total of 7 presentations.

authors: Venkat Venkatasubramanian | Columbia University, New York, NY
